repos.description: 🔥 今日热榜 API，一个聚合热门数据的 API 接口，支持 RSS 模式 及 Vercel 部署 | 前端页面：https://github.com/imsyy/DailyHot
repos.summary_zh: 聚合多平台热点数据的轻量级API接口，支持JSON与RSS格式，提供哔哩哔哩、微博、知乎等数十条热榜数据。响应迅速，部署简便，适用于数据抓取、热点追踪及个性化RSS订阅服务。
repos.summary_en: An aggregated hot trends API supporting JSON and RSS formats, pulling real-time data from major platforms like Bilibili, Weibo, Zhihu, and Douyin. Lightweight, fast, and easily deployable on Vercel, perfect for developers building custom feeds or tracking viral topics.

repos.description: 实时监控网页变化，并发送通知（Monitor web page changes in real time and send notifications）
repos.summary_zh: WebMonitor 是一款实时网页变更监控工具，支持动态抓取与灵活的数据提取。它集成邮件、微信、Telegram 等多通道通知，提供可视化界面与规则配置，助力高效实现网页信息自动化监控与告警。
repos.summary_en: WebMonitor is a real-time web page change monitoring tool that supports dynamic scraping and flexible data extraction. It integrates multi-channel notifications like email, WeChat, and Telegram, providing a visual UI for easy configuration and automated web info surveillance.

repos.description: 监测RSS变动，并发送最新内容到微信、Webhook 和 Telegram, Discord, Slack, Amazon SNS, Gotify 等数十个消息通道。
repos.summary_zh: RSSPush 是一款基于 Docker 的 Web 应用，实时监控 RSS 源内容变化，并自动将最新消息推送到微信、Telegram、Discord 等数十个消息通道。支持 HTTP 代理、关键词过滤、自动翻译等功能，可结合 RSSHub 使用，适用于个人和团队的信息自动化推送场景。
repos.summary_en: RSSPush is a Docker-based web application that monitors RSS feed changes in real-time and automatically pushes the latest content to dozens of messaging channels such as WeChat, Telegram, and Discord. It supports HTTP proxies, keyword filtering, auto-translation, and can integrate with RSSHub, making it ideal for automated information pushing for individuals and teams.
